name: starfield-warp-speed
title: Starfield Warp Speed
description: Canvas 3D starfield simulation with stars accelerating toward the camera creating a hyperspace warp effect.
designRules:
# Design System

Genre: Technical
Macrostructure: Full Bleed
Density: Dense
Shape: Pill
Motion: Kinetic
Typography: Monospace
Color: High Contrast

## Rules

- Passive Canvas Warp: the interaction model is part of the design, not an add-on.
- Reduced motion replaces animation with a state change; nothing is hidden behind motion.
- The component composes through `cn` and never hardcodes colours.

## Avoid

- Reskinning this resource and republishing it under a new name.
- Adding shadows or radii that contradict its shape language.
